meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: 网页与数字界面设计师在构建Web页面或应用组件时，若受够了千篇一律的AI味设计，请用此技能。一键生成极具视觉冲击力、排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码，告别平庸，打造令人难忘的高品质数字界面。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成排版独特、动效惊艳的生产级前端代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果受够了千篇一律的AI味网页设计
copy.tagline_en: Generate production-grade frontend code with unique typography and stunning motion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are tired of generic AI-look web designs

howto.what: 它会先定下大胆的设计方向——用途、基调、约束、以及让人记住的那一点,再写出能运行的前端代码(HTML/CSS/JS、React、Vue 等),在字体、配色、动效、布局上按选定风格细化。
howto.when: 当你要构建网页、页面板块或应用组件,并且想摆脱千篇一律的 AI 味设计时触发。

say.text: 用这个技能给我做一个产品落地页,走粗野主义风格
say.note: 它会先确认设计方向再产出代码

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 价格卡片组件,要奢华精致路线
say.note: 产出可运行的组件代码

say.text: 把这个页面改成复古未来风,别再用 Inter 和紫色渐变
say.note: 按新风格重做字体与配色

howto.what_en: It first commits to a bold design direction — purpose, tone, constraints, one memorable hook — then writes working frontend code (HTML/CSS/JS, React, Vue, etc.), refining typography, color, motion and layout to that vision.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build a web page, page section or app component and want to avoid generic AI-looking design.

say_en.text: Make me a product landing page in a brutalist style
say_en.note: It confirms direction, then writes the code

say_en.text: Write a React pricing card component, luxury and refined
Restyle this page retro-futuristic, drop Inter and purple gradients
say_en.note: Reworks fonts and colors to the new style
